integrity: Exact source-to-claim spectral derivation is self-contained in RESULT.md. Finite tests in verify.py check ten sample designs; they are supportive, not an infinite proof. Research statements have self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Only finite unweighted incidence graphs of symmetric 2-(v,k,lambda) designs with k-lambda>=2. Resonance criterion is exact but existence of resonant nontrivial design parameters is unresolved. No claim about other designs or weighted metrics. Independence and historical priority have not been independently verified.
title: Two competing Hilbert-snowflake obstructions for symmetric-design incidence graphs
